vendor_build._note: Upstream's release workflow (.github/workflows/base-release.yaml) runs `make generate-sources` with DISTRIBUTIONS=<dist>; that target is `go ocb generate-msi prepare-obi` + `scripts/build.sh -d <dist> -s true`. Only two of those produce Go source: `make ocb` (go install go.opentelemetry.io/collector/cmd/builder@v$(OTELCOL_BUILDER_VERSION) -> $HOME/bin/ocb; the Makefile pins 0.163.0 at v0.163.2 via renovate) and build.sh -s true (ocb --skip-compilation=true --config manifest.yaml -> _build/{go.mod,go.sum,main.go,main_others.go,main_windows.go,components.go}, after its own go mod tidy). generate-msi only writes the Windows installer definition and prepare-obi is a no-op for any distribution but otelcol-contrib, so both are skipped. The generated main.go carries the version as a literal (BuildInfo{Version: "0.163.2"} at v0.163.2, from the manifest's dist.version), so the binary needs no -X ldflags at all.

source._version_note: v0.163.2 is the latest GA tag of opentelemetry-collector-releases (published 2026-10-21; v0.163.0 and v0.163.1 on 2026-10-16; the v0.164.0-nightly.* tags are nightlies, and cmd/builder/* and cmd/opampsupervisor/* are sub-module tags, all excluded by retarget_tag_pattern). Read at the tag on 2026-10-21: distributions/otelcol/manifest.yaml sets dist.version 0.163.2 and pins every component at v0.163.0 (core and contrib modules; the same component list as v0.162.0's manifest: 7 receivers, 9 exporters, 3 extensions, 7 processors, 1 connector, 5 providers) and the confmap providers at v1.69.0; the Makefile pins OTELCOL_BUILDER_VERSION 0.163.0; scripts/build.sh and distributions/otelcol/.goreleaser.yaml are unchanged from v0.162.0. Every pinned component module and ocb v0.163.0's own go.mod declare `go 1.26.0`, so the generated go.mod is go 1.26.0 after tidy (read from the modules' go.mod files, not yet measured on a generated module at this tag). The builder is golang:1.26.10-bookworm under GOTOOLCHAIN=local (in BASE_IMAGE_DIGESTS.lock since 2026-10-21), the toolchain upstream's v0.163.2 release workflows require (go ~1.26.10; CHANGELOG v0.163.2: Go 1.26.10 carries the crypto/x509 security fix of 2026-10-19, GO-2026-6809 / CVE-2026-111943). No go.work anywhere.

binaries_from_source.name: otelcol
binaries_from_source._ldflags_note: No -X: the version is a literal in the ocb-generated main.go (component.BuildInfo{Command: "otelcol", Version: "0.163.2"} at v0.163.2), cobra prints it as `otelcol version 0.163.2`. verify_contains still guards the openbao class of failure in its other form: a retarget that moves ref but builds a tree whose manifest dist.version says something else fails the build instead of shipping a mislabelled binary. -s -w and -trimpath match distributions/otelcol/.goreleaser.yaml (LD_FLAGS=-s -w, BUILD_FLAGS=-trimpath, CGO_ENABLED=0).
binaries_from_source._tags_note: grpcnotrace is the manifest's own dist.build_tags. goreleaser does not pass it (only ocb's own compile step would), so the official release binaries are built WITHOUT it; we follow the manifest's declared intent because it drops grpc's golang.org/x/net/trace debug pages from the binary - less code, less CVE surface, no behaviour a collector user relies on. Verified to compile and run at v0.162.0 (see _README).
